reason: At $24.99 with money back even if the box is empty, I can risk one box. The named lab and the report for my batch make it feel less like a random TikTok supplement, and the pre-counted sachets are easy to throw in my bag when I travel.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? If I take all 30 and nothing changes, I've spent a chunk of my budget and have to go through the hassle of writing in for a refund.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was $29.99 or more for the first box, I'd probably scroll past.
